Before proceeding, you must have the following resources.
Prerequisite
Description
Amazon S3 bucket
For more information, see Create your ﬁrst S3 bucket in the Amazon
Simple Storage Service User Guide. The bucket must reside in the same
Region as your OpenSearch Service domain.
OpenSearch Service
domain
The destination for data after your Lambda function processes it.
For more information, see the section called “ Creating OpenSearch
Service domains”.
